description: Implementation of a random number generator for the quiche library, including platform-specific thread-local RNG state management and methods for generating secure and insecure random bytes.

classes.name: DefaultQuicheRandom
classes.description: Default implementation of QuicheRandom providing secure and insecure random byte generation.

methods.name: DefaultQuicheRandom::RandBytes
methods.description: Fills buffer with cryptographically secure random bytes using OpenSSL.

methods.name: DefaultQuicheRandom::RandUint64
methods.description: Returns a secure random 64-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: DefaultQuicheRandom::InsecureRandBytes
methods.description: Fills buffer with insecure random bytes using a xoshiro256++ implementation.

methods.name: DefaultQuicheRandom::InsecureRandUint64
methods.description: Returns an insecure random 64-bit unsigned integer.
